title: Story Arc Builder
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Challenger Selling
description: Drag-and-drop builder in which learners sequence four elements of an IoT customer story into Setup, Rising Action, Climax and Resolution, then see the resulting tension curve.

learningObjectives: Construct a story arc by sequencing story elements (setup, rising action, climax, resolution) for a given sales scenario.

keyQuestions: Construct a story arc by sequencing story elements (setup, rising action, climax, resolution) for a given sales scenario.
commonMisconceptions: All stories follow the same arc.
The climax always comes at the end.
assessmentOpportunities: All four elements are placed in the correct slot.
Learner can explain why the climax is the peak of tension, not the end of the story.
